title: Checkout has both timeouts and rejected orders
prompt: Since 13:20 UTC checkout p95 is 12 seconds and roughly 18% of orders fail. Operators suspect one shared dependency. Determine all material root causes and explain how each contributes to the incident.

evidence.summary: Checkout shows two distinct failure populations
evidence.content: 61% of slow requests spend over 9 s in inventory Reserve; 18% of all requests fail after a 3 s payment connection timeout. The populations overlap in only 4% of traces.

evidence.summary: Failed orders cannot connect to the configured processor
evidence.content: Trace checkout/aa1: payment Charge -> tcp connect 10.99.14.77:8443 timeout at 3.0 s -> order rejected PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE.

evidence.summary: Payment endpoint changed to an unused address
evidence.content: Config revision 448 changed PROCESSOR_ENDPOINT from processor.internal:8443 to 10.99.14.77:8443. Service inventory has no endpoint registered at 10.99.14.77.

evidence.summary: Slow orders wait in inventory reservation queries
evidence.content: Trace checkout/bb2: inventory Reserve 11.4 s, including SQL SELECT reservation WHERE sku=? AND warehouse_id=? consuming 11.1 s; payment completes in 88 ms.

evidence.summary: Reservation query performs a full table scan
evidence.content: EXPLAIN shows Seq Scan on reservation, 28.4 million rows examined, because no index covers (sku, warehouse_id). Before schema revision 912 the query used reservation_sku_warehouse_idx.

evidence.summary: Inventory schema migration removed the reservation index
evidence.content: Migration 912 dropped reservation_sku_warehouse_idx while replacing an unrelated uniqueness constraint; no replacement lookup index was created.

evidence.summary: Authentication CPU rises but remains within its SLO
evidence.content: authentication-service CPU rose from 22% to 58% after a traffic shift; auth p95 stayed at 46 ms and no auth errors occurred.
checkout CPU 32%, memory 40%, queue depth 3, and zero pod restarts. Latency is entirely within downstream spans.
